dedupe_keys.name: малинська міська рада public transport datasets

description: Малинська міська рада: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Малинська міська рада. Coverage: Малинська міська рада. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Дані про місце розміщення зупинок міського транспорту; Розклад руху громадського транспорту міста Малина; Дані про транспортні засоби, які обслуговують пасажирські маршрути пер. Formats seen: XLSX, XSLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
